description: This file contains tests for context visibility functions related to different modes and inclusion criteria, specifically testing evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility, shouldIncludeSupplementalContext, and filterSupplementalContextItems.

methods.name: evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility
methods.description: Determines if supplemental context should be included based on mode, kind, and sender allowance.

methods.name: shouldIncludeSupplementalContext
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether to include the supplemental context based on current mode, kind, and sender allowance.

methods.name: filterSupplementalContextItems
methods.description: Filters context items based on sender allowance and mode, returning filtered items and omitted count.
